verses.text: Your tongue devises destruction, Like a sharp razor, O worker of deceit.
You love evil more than good, Falsehood more than speaking what is right. Selah.
You love all words that devour, O deceitful tongue.
But God will break you down forever; He will snatch you up, and tear you away from your tent, And uproot you from the land of the living. Selah.
And the righteous will see and fear, And will laugh at him, saying,
“Behold, the man who would not make God his refuge, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And was strong in his evil desire.”
But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the lovingkindness of God forever and ever.
I will give Thee thanks forever, because Thou hast done it , And I will wait on Thy name, for it is good, in the presence of Thy godly ones.
